accounts_tenant.name: accounts_tenant
accounts_tenant.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users u WHERE u.id = accounts.user_id AND u.operator_id = app.current_operator())
accounts_tenant.withCheck: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users u WHERE u.id = accounts.user_id AND u.operator_id = app.current_operator())

devices_revoked_by_needs_revoked_at.name: devices_revoked_by_needs_revoked_at
devices_revoked_by_needs_revoked_at.value: "devices"."revoked_by" IS NULL OR "devices"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

sessions_tenant.name: sessions_tenant
sessions_tenant.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users u WHERE u.id = sessions.user_id AND u.operator_id = app.current_operator())
sessions_tenant.withCheck: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users u WHERE u.id = sessions.user_id AND u.operator_id = app.current_operator())

users_login_normalized.name: users_login_normalized
users_login_normalized.value: "users"."login" = lower("users"."login") AND "users"."login" !~ '[[:space:]]' AND char_length("users"."login") BETWEEN 3 AND 100

adjustments_rental_sources_name_connecti.name: adjustments_rental_sources_name_connection
adjustments_rental_sources_name_connecti.value:
"adjustments"."source" NOT IN ('plan_change', 'mid_month_start')
        OR ("adjustments"."assignment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "adjustments"."period" IS NOT NULL)

invoice_lines_shape.name: invoice_lines_shape
invoice_lines_shape.value:
CASE WHEN "invoice_lines"."type" = 'rent'
        THEN "invoice_lines"."assignment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_lines"."adjustment_id" IS NULL AND "invoice_lines"."amount_paise" >= 0
        ELSE "invoice_lines"."adjustment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_lines"."amount_paise" > 0
        END

invoices_void_metadata.name: invoices_void_metadata
invoices_void_metadata.value:
CASE WHEN "invoices"."status" = 'void'
        THEN "invoices"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(btrim("invoices"."void_reason"), '') <> ''
        ELSE "invoices"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "invoices"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "invoices"."void_reason" IS NULL
        END

collection_sessions_handover_iff_submitt.name: collection_sessions_handover_iff_submitted
collection_sessions_handover_iff_submitt.value:
CASE WHEN "collection_sessions"."status" = 'open'
        THEN "collection_sessions"."handover_submission_id" IS NULL AND "collection_sessions"."handover_cash_expected_paise" IS NULL
          AND "collection_sessions"."cash_handed_over_paise" IS NULL AND "collection_sessions"."discrepancy_paise" IS NULL
          AND "collection_sessions"."discrepancy_reason" IS NULL AND "collection_sessions"."handover_note" IS NULL
          AND "collection_sessions"."unsynced_payment_count" IS NULL AND "collection_sessions"."unsynced_cash_paise" IS NULL
          AND "collection_sessions"."submitted_at" IS NULL
        ELSE "collection_sessions"."handover_submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "collection_sessions"."handover_cash_expected_paise" IS NOT NULL
          AND "collection_sessions"."cash_handed_over_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "collection_sessions"."discrepancy_paise" IS NOT NULL
          AND "collection_sessions"."unsynced_payment_count" IS NOT NULL AND "collection_sessions"."unsynced_cash_paise" IS NOT NULL
          AND "collection_sessions"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL
        END

collection_sessions_discrepancy_needs_re.name: collection_sessions_discrepancy_needs_reason
collection_sessions_discrepancy_needs_re.value: "collection_sessions"."discrepancy_paise" IS NULL OR "collection_sessions"."discrepancy_paise" = 0 OR "collection_sessions"."discrepancy_reason" IS NOT NULL

collection_sessions_review.name: collection_sessions_review
collection_sessions_review.value:
CASE WHEN "collection_sessions"."status" IN ('accepted', 'returned')
        THEN "collection_sessions"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "collection_sessions"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND ("collection_sessions"."status" = 'accepted' OR coalesce(btrim("collection_sessions"."review_note"), '') <> '')
        ELSE "collection_sessions"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "collection_sessions"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "collection_sessions"."review_note" IS NULL
        END

assignment_events_plan_values.name: assignment_events_plan_values
assignment_events_plan_values.value:
CASE WHEN "assignment_events"."type" = 'plan_changed'
        THEN "assignment_events"."from_rental_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "assignment_events"."to_rental_paise" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "assignment_events"."from_plan_id" IS NULL AND "assignment_events"."to_plan_id" IS NULL
          AND "assignment_events"."from_rental_paise" IS NULL AND "assignment_events"."to_rental_paise" IS NULL
        END

handover_events_snapshot_iff_submitted.name: handover_events_snapshot_iff_submitted
handover_events_snapshot_iff_submitted.value:
CASE WHEN "handover_events"."type" = 'submitted'
        THEN "handover_events"."cash_expected_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "handover_events"."cash_handed_over_paise" IS NOT NULL
          AND "handover_events"."discrepancy_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "handover_events"."unsynced_payment_count" IS NOT NULL
          AND "handover_events"."unsynced_cash_paise" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "handover_events"."cash_expected_paise" IS NULL AND "handover_events"."cash_handed_over_paise" IS NULL
          AND "handover_events"."discrepancy_paise" IS NULL AND "handover_events"."discrepancy_reason" IS NULL
          AND "handover_events"."unsynced_payment_count" IS NULL AND "handover_events"."unsynced_cash_paise" IS NULL
        END

handover_events_discrepancy_needs_reason.name: handover_events_discrepancy_needs_reason
handover_events_discrepancy_needs_reason.value: "handover_events"."discrepancy_paise" IS NULL OR "handover_events"."discrepancy_paise" = 0 OR "handover_events"."discrepancy_reason" IS NOT NULL

allocations_one_source.name: allocations_one_source
allocations_one_source.value:
CASE WHEN "allocations"."source_type" = 'payment'
        THEN "allocations"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "allocations"."credit_adjustment_id" IS NULL
        ELSE "allocations"."credit_adjustment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "allocations"."payment_id" IS NULL
        END

allocations_reversal_shape.name: allocations_reversal_shape
allocations_reversal_shape.value:
CASE WHEN "allocations"."kind" = 'reversal'
        THEN "allocations"."amount_paise" < 0 AND "allocations"."source_type" = 'payment'
          AND "allocations"."reversal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "allocations"."reverses_allocation_id" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "allocations"."amount_paise" > 0 AND "allocations"."reversal_id" IS NULL AND "allocations"."reverses_allocation_id" IS NULL
        END

ledger_entries_reference_and_sign.name: ledger_entries_reference_and_sign
ledger_entries_reference_and_sign.value:
CASE "ledger_entries"."type"
        WHEN 'invoice' THEN "ledger_entries"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."amount_paise" >= 0
        WHEN 'opening_balance' THEN "ledger_entries"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."amount_paise" >= 0
        WHEN 'debit_adjustment' THEN "ledger_entries"."adjustment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."amount_paise" > 0
        WHEN 'credit_adjustment' THEN "ledger_entries"."adjustment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."amount_paise" < 0
        WHEN 'payment' THEN "ledger_entries"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."amount_paise" < 0
        WHEN 'payment_reversal' THEN "ledger_entries"."payment_reversal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."amount_paise" > 0
        END

payments_snapshots_required.name: payments_snapshots_required
payments_snapshots_required.value:
"payments"."source" = 'migration'
        OR ("payments"."balance_after_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."credit_after_paise" IS NOT NULL)

payments_review_resolution.name: payments_review_resolution
payments_review_resolution.value:
CASE WHEN "payments"."review_status" = 'resolved'
        THEN "payments"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "payments"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "payments"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "payments"."review_note" IS NULL
        END

receipt_links_revoked_by_needs_revoked_a.name: receipt_links_revoked_by_needs_revoked_at
receipt_links_revoked_by_needs_revoked_a.value: "receipt_links"."revoked_by" IS NULL OR "receipt_links"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
